verdict.rationale: Paperspace is a GPU cloud and ML infrastructure platform (VMs, Notebooks, Deployments), not an agent or AI host that consumes tools. Asking whether it acts as an MCP client is therefore a category error. The MCP evidence in the pack concerns DigitalOcean's own MCP servers (the server role) and a separate DigitalOcean Managed Agents product, neither of which shows Paperspace itself plugging in MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
